boards.name: Reed
boards.notes: Developer page lists a Jobs API for posting jobs and a Jobseeker API for search. Whether a key is needed, how access is requested, and whether it is free are not stated on the page. Employer pricing shown as From only 89 pounds for new customers in the recruiter section, model not stated. Footer lists related brand Reed Group Services; parent not stated. No language options found.

boards.name: LinkedIn Jobs
boards.notes: Footer language list shows English (English) as the selected option; no other languages seen on pages read. Developer site has app creation and an Apply now step for one API; access rules not stated on pages read. Only two public pages read (homepage and developer site) to limit automated access.

boards.notes: Part of Jisc; registered office in Bristol, England. Homepage shows prices from 370 pounds under employer advertising, model not stated. Employers page returned 404. No API or integration mention found on pages read.
